prerequisites: The TFG must be defended and evaluated once it has been reliably confirmed that the student has passed all remaining subjects of the study plan and therefore has all the necessary credits to obtain the Degree, except those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to integrate all general and specific competencies within the scope of the Degree studies completed.

Specific learning outcomes of the End-of-Degree Project will vary depending on the topic assigned by the tutor but, as a general rule, will be directly related to the specific objectives of the degree.

These results will be reflected in the individual completion, presentation, and defense before a university tribunal of an original project in the field of Engineering of a professional nature, in which all acquired competencies are synthesized and integrated.

syllabus_topics: Topics within the area of Engineering in which the student has completed their studies, as indicated in the objectives of each qualification.

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring of the student's face-to-face activities by their academic tutor
Final document presented by the student
Public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent debate with it

assessment_rules: The End-of-Degree Project must be presented and defended before a university tribunal. The evaluation will generally assess the monitoring of face-to-face activities, the final document presented, and the public presentation and debate. The final definition of the evaluation system will adhere to the regulations defined in the End-of-Degree Project Regulation of the School of Engineering. Both ordinary and extraordinary evaluations are conducted through a public presentation before a tribunal of three professors.
